pub use index::index;
pub use summary::summary;

=== create src/controllers/reports/index.rs
//! `GET /reports`. Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller reports index summary`.

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::views::{self, Ctx, reports::ReportsIndex};

/// `GET /reports`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn index(
    ctx: Ctx,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    Ok(views::render(ReportsIndex {
        ctx: ctx.titled("Reports"),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create src/controllers/reports/summary.rs

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

use crate::error::AppError;

/// `GET /reports/summary`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn summary(
    ctx: Ctx,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    Ok(views::render(ReportsSummary {
        ctx: ctx.titled("Reports summary"),
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create src/views/reports.rs
//! Page structs for reports. Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller reports index summary`.

use askama::Template;

use super::Ctx;
// The layout links with `paths::`.
use crate::routes::paths;

/// `GET /reports`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "reports/index.html")]
pub struct ReportsIndex {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
}

/// `GET /reports/summary`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "reports/summary.html")]
pub struct ReportsSummary {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
}

=== wire src/views/mod.rs @ samples: view mods
pub mod reports; // reports

=== create src/routes/reports.rs
//! Reports (`cargo offrails generate controller reports`): its router, `paths::` helpers and `ROUTES` rows.
//! src/routes.rs wires it in with one `// reports` line at `route mods`, `routes`, `paths`, `route tables`.

use axum::{Router, routing::get};

use super::{Access, Route};
use crate::state::AppState;

pub fn router() -> Router<AppState> {
    Router::new()
        .route("/reports", get(crate::controllers::reports::index))
        .route("/reports/summary", get(crate::controllers::reports::summary))
}

/// URL helpers; `crate::routes::paths` re-exports them.
pub mod paths {
    pub fn reports() -> String {
        "/reports".into()
    }

    pub fn reports_summary() -> String {
        "/reports/summary".into()
    }
}

#[rustfmt::skip]
pub const ROUTES: &[Route] = &[
    ("GET",  "/reports",         "reports::index",   Access::Public),
    ("GET",  "/reports/summary", "reports::summary", Access::Public),
];

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: route mods
pub mod reports; // reports

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: routes
app = app.merge(reports::router()); // reports

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: paths
pub use super::reports::paths::*; // reports

=== create tests/app/reports_test.rs
//! Reports (src/controllers/reports/). Generated by `cargo offrails generate controller reports index summary`.
//! APP: assert what each page shows, citing its AC (`/// AC-reports-1`).

use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use crate::support::TestApp;

#[tokio::test]
async fn index_renders() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::reports())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text("Reports");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn summary_renders() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::reports_summary())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_text("Reports summary");
}

=== wire tests/app/main.rs @ samples: test mods
mod reports_test; // reports
